A predominance of blighted properties clearly exists within the project, which, by reason of dilapidated or deteriorating structures on these properties or the presence of blighting influences throughout the entire project area, are detrimental to the safety, health, morals and welfare of the community. The entire project has been determined to be a blighted, deteriorated and deteriorating area warranting clearance and redevelopment and conservation treatment by public agency and private enterprise.
The intended residential reuses and the residential densities 2. were determined with and planned primarily for the present inhabitants of the project area. To encourage home ownership opportunities a variety of housing types will be built including single family attached and detached units. Low and medium density multiple family apartments will have restricted lot coverage and be required to provide usable open space for residents of the developments. Newly constructed elderly housing units, as well rehabilitated multifamily structures that will include appropriate facilities for their needs will be provided for Randolph senior citizens. Auto-oriented convenience type commercial areas will be developed around existing and established auto-oriented businesses adjacent to high volume traffic and at a major community access point. Pedestrian oriented commercial development will be developed adjacent to the highest concentration of multiple family units. Semi-public areas consist of existing churches and service agencies. Public areas will complement proposed residential areas. A major recreational complex takes advantage of an existing school building, playground, and swimming pool and adds open space and a multi-use field, as well as converting the school into a multi-purpose recreational neighborhood center. Other public use proposals include the conversion of the four room Sidney School (a special education facility) into a community building. A well defined pedestrian walkway system will connect the major physical elements within the project.
